classification.difficultyReason: Choose two rectangle triangles with opposite-side equalities and included right angles, apply familiar SAS and identify corresponding diagonals; short direct proof.

content.prompt: Draw a diagram and prove that diagonals of a rectangle are equal.

answer.worked: In rectangle ABCD, $BA=DC$ and $AD=CB$ (opposite sides), and $\angle BAD=\angle DCB=90^\circ$. Thus $\triangle BAD\cong\triangle DCB$ by SAS. Corresponding sides give $BD=CA$, so the diagonals are equal.
